messages:
jade: Quick sync — want to lock speaker picks + a staggered rehearsal plan so we cover PST/CET/SGT without blowing up people's mornings. sketch below. Thoughts?

mohit: Love it. Can we make the demos split into 2x short runs (15m) + 1x full run (30m)? reduces blast radius.

elaine: +1. Also we should pair each speaker with an ops buddy for demo fallback (who will trigger the Dedicated failover).

patrick: Ops buddy = @samir for infra and @olga for audience routing? both ok for me.

olga: Happy to own audience routing. Thinking two lead-collection flows: "trial-signup" for post-demo, and "enterprise-interest" for sales handoff. Need lead scripts.

samir: Can confirm Dedicated fallback runbook. Add a tiny play: `if latency > 400ms for 2m -> switch to variant-b-quant` and M-triage channel = #release-war-room.

jade: Draft schedule (UTC):
```
- 08:00 UTC: Tech-check (hosts + ops buddies) 20m
- 08:30 UTC: Speaker A rehearsal (PST-friendly 15m)
- 09:00 UTC: Speaker B rehearsal (CET slot 15m)
- 11:30 UTC: Full run with all speakers + Q&A walk-through 30m
```
Link to tentative calendar: https://calendar.example.com/event/abc123 (private)

mohit: Can we stagger so no speaker does >2 rehearsals? maybe do one short + the full run.

elaine: I'll own speaker prep doc — will add checklist: mic test, camera, demo seed data, api-key perms, and a small prompt set (5 prompts) for regression checks.

olga: For inbound routing: define two tags on leads: `webinar-demo` and `webinar-sla`. `webinar-sla` goes to sales queue immediately, others get automated nurture.

patrick: Rehearsal assignment:
- Speaker A: mic check + short run (08:30) + full run
- Speaker B: short run (09:00) + full run
- Ops buddies join all runs

samir: Add a quick command snippet for ops buddies to test failover locally:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.inference/fallback -d '{"model":"variant-b-quant","duration":30}' -H "Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>"
```

marketing-bot: Reminder set: `/remind #marketing in 48h finalize speaker one-pagers`

jade: Thanks everyone — I'll spin up a single pager for each speaker + a one-sheet for ops. tagging next steps: @mohit build demo prompts, @elaine speaker one-pagers, @olga lead routing rules, @samir ops runbook by EOD tomorrow. If nobody objects, I'll lock the calendar in 6h. :thumbsup:
